A “Setu” coin with a bull on the obverse: Ko kaalis “Setu” mo nagge woni e dow mum. Konngol Setu — ponto feewde Lanka, to Rameswaram — ina feeñi e kaalis laamɓe Tamil en e nder yontaaji cakkitiiɗi ɗii, e nder laamu Jaffna ; nagge couchant, Shiva’s Nandi, ko kaɓirgal maɓɓe keewngal.
A burial urn of the kind that made Adich: Urne wirwirnde e sifaa mo Adichanallur waɗi lollude. Maayɓe ɓee — walla ƴiye mum en mooftaaɗe — mbaɗetee e nder urneeji hono ɗii, tawa ina njogii geɗe yanaande, mberlee e leydi kaaƴe dow Thamirabarani. Urneeji ɗii ko jokkondiral toowngal e முதுமக்கள் தாழி jimɗi Sangam.
A catalogue of the coins issued by the C: Catal kaalis mo laamɓe Chera, Chola, e Pandya njaltini, e maandeeji mum en laamɗo, ko wayi no bow, tiggu, e liɗɗi.
A ceramic vessel from Adichanallur. Smal: Ko mbaydi seraamik ummoriindi Adichanallur. Pottitte tokoose hono ɗee ina mbaɗee e nder walla saraaji urneeji wirwirnde, ma a taw ina njogii nguura, ndiyam walla sadakeeji maayɓe — ko ɗum ƴeewndo goongɗinal jamaanu njamndi e yahdu caggal maayde.
A chariot for a creeper, a shawl for a p: Puccu wonande ɓiɗɗo gorko, 6uu6ol wonande 6icfcfo 6aleejo, 6icfcfo nguurndam wonande yimoowo : dokke patrons’en 6urcfe lollude ina nanndi e ko 6eydaaka, ko cfuum woni to66ere ma66e. Kodai madam ko yaafuya keewɗo haa dokkuɗo oo hiisataa kuutoragol dokkal ngal — yurmeende yaajnde e daabaaji, leɗɗe e jaŋde fof.
A Chera coin in the collection of the Na: Ko mbuuɗu Chera e nder defterdu Napier, to Tiruvanantapuram. Koyɗe Chera ina njogii sifaaji jogiiɗi bow e arrow, maande laamu nguu, e yeruuji keewɗi aranndeeji ummorii ko e Karur, caka Chera dow Amaravathi.
A chieftain of the Ay line in the southe: Mawɗo liggey Ay e nder leydi tufnde Podiyil (Pothigai) to bannge worgo. Aadaaji anndaaɗi ina kaala ko fayti e hokkude laamɗo oo comci tedduɗi, ɗi yimɓe fof nganndi ko Shiva — hokkude ko dewal kam e yaafuya.
A chieftain of the Malaiyaman lineage, o: Mawɗo leñol Malaiyaman, leydi taariindi Mullur e Tirukkoyilur, siftortee ko e moƴƴere mum e yimooɓe e kala arɗo e makko. Nokku makko e nder patrons jeeɗiɗi ɗii ina hollita wonde teddungal laamɗo ina fotnoo fotde e dokkugol makko no fotiri e leydi makko.
A Chola coin carrying Pandya royal insig: Ko mbuuɗu Chola ina jogii maande laamɗo Pandya. Nde Cholas en ngaddi leydi Pandya e les njiimaandi mum en, ɓe mbaɗi liɗɗi Pandya ɗii sara tiggu maɓɓe — maande haɓde e njamndi.
A city where literature, royal patronage: Wuro ɗo binndol, patronage laamɗo, diine e nguurndam wuro kawri ko ina wona duuɓi ujunnaaje ɗiɗi.
A coin of Kulottunga Chola bearing the t: Kosam Kulottunga Chola ina jogii tiitoonde “Malai Nadu konda Chola” — Chola ƴettuɗo leydi tufnde, woni leydi Chera. Laamɓe Chola ina kollita nafooje mum en e tiitooɗe ɗe ɓe mbinndi e kaalis maɓɓe kam e ɗe ɓe mbinndi e binndi maɓɓe.
A coin of Kulottunga I (1070–1120 CE), w: Koɗo Kulottunga I (1070-1120 CE), mo hawti laabi Chola e Fuɗnaange Chalukya, laami gooto e laamuuji Chola ɓurɗi juutde e ɓurɗi alɗude. Koyɗe makko ina njokki e sifaaji Chola tabitinaaɗi e innde makko e ɗemngal Nagari.
A coin of Rajaraja I. His copper coins o: Kosam Rajaraja I. Kosam makko njamndi mboɗeeri, hono laamɗo dariiɗo e jooɗiiɗo, naatnooɗo caggal nde o heɓti fuɗnaange Sri Lanka, ina cirƴa no feewi banngeeji ɗiɗi ɗii kala, ina yeñtina ɗum fotde teeminanɗe.
A coin of the Jaffna kingdom showing a h: Kosam laamu Jaffna holliroowo puccu ina wondi e liɗɗi. Laamɓe Tamil en Jaffna (teeminannde 13ɓiire haa 17ɓiire) njaltinii kaalis e nder aadaaji Inndo fuɗnaange, siftorde jokkondiral tiiɗngal hakkunde maayo Palk.
A coin of the Kongu Cheras, the Chera li: Ko kaalis Kongu Cheras, laana Chera laaminooka leydi Kongu to diiwaan Tamil hirnaange (hedde Coimbatore, Erode e Karur hannde) — ko diiwaan gooto rokki kaalis keewɗo kaalis Roomnaaɓe.
A crowned, moustached figure in profile,: Limre korona, ɓuuɓnde e nder profil, ɓoorniiɗo jacket jeewte e ɓuuɓri ɓuuɓndi, ina ummina sawru ɓuuɓndu. Yeeso e juuɗe ina njuutee e laylaytol ɓalewol laaɓngol e dow leydi ɓuuɓndi e limce loowaaɗe e okra, pink e ɓaleejo — ko nanndi e natal janngugol mbaydi laamɗo e nder pentol suudu dewal.
A detail of the painted ceiling of the J: Detaay pentiirɗo e ceŋol caalli Jain to Sittanavasal : looɗe pinɗe udditooje hakkunde paddorɗe ɓaleeje, daaba ina ƴaañii e ndiyam e nate mooftuɗe puɗi. Poolgu nguu ina heewi janngeede ko no ɓuuɓri lotus samavasarana, mooɓondiral asamaan ɗo Tirthankara Jain waajotoo, e gooŋɗinɓe mooɓooɓe puɗi ngam sakkude.
A funerary vessel from the burial cairns: Laana wirwirnde ummoraade e kaaƴe wirwirnde e dow tule Nilgiri, ɓuuɓri mum ina waɗi nate mbaylaaɗe. Waɗooɓe ɓulli Nilgiri e nder teeminannde sappo e jeenay (19) tawi ko heewi e ɓulli ɗii ina njogii yimɓe, daabaaji e yahooɓe — dille tokoose e nder loope ina mbaawi hollirde nguurndam e ngonka maayɓe.
A garland of about a hundred and fifty a: Garland ko ina wona teemedere e capanɗe joyi aayaaji akam ɗi Kanimethaviyar winndi, ko ina wona capanɗe tati e kala leydi joy.
A gold coin of Rajaraja I (985–1014 CE),: Ko mbuuɗu kaŋŋe mo Rajaraja I (985-1014), mahoowo suudu dewal mawndu to Thanjavur. Ina hollita maande laamɗo Chola ɓooynde : tiggu jooɗiiɗo ina wondi e liɗɗi ɗiɗi Pandya, les parasol njiimaandi, ina waɗi innde laamɗo oo e ɗemngal Nagari — Chola en ina mbiya ina laama fuɗnaange.
A gold half-kahavanu of Virarajendra Cho: Feccere kaŋŋe kaŋŋe mo Virajendra Chola (1063-1070 CE). Kahavanu (ummoraade e kahapana) ko diine kaŋŋe Sri Lanka, kaŋŋe Chola fiyaaɗo e ooɗoo tolno ina hollita sahaa laamu Chola e dow duunde ndee.
A guide poem of the Ten Idylls by Kadiya: Yimre njiylawu e nder Idiluuji sappo ɗi Kadiyalur Uruthirankannanar winndi. Bard gooto jogiiɗo yazh mawɗo ina ardii haa to Thondaiman Ilanthiraiyan mo Kanchi; e nder laawol ngol jimɗi ɗii ina penta nate gure, portooji, e yimɓe.
A guide poem of the Ten Idylls by Mudath: Yimre njiylawu e nder jimɗi sappo ɗi Mudathama Kanniyar winndi. Bardoowo (porunar) mo njoɓdi mum heewi, ina ardoo banndiiko bardiiɗo to laamɗo Chola mo moƴƴere mum woni Karikal Valavan.
A guide poem of the Ten Idylls by Nallur: Yimre njiylawu e nder Idiluuji sappo ɗi Nallur Natanar winndi. Bardoowo fiyoowo yazh (harp) tokooso ina ardoo goɗɗo to mawɗo Nalliyakkodan, ina siftina caɗeele bardiiɓe miskineeɓe e weltaare patron jom jawdi.
A guide poem of the Ten Idylls by Perunk: Yimre njiylawu e nder Idilleeji sappo ɗi Perunkausikanar winndi. Waɗooɓe njilluuji (koothar) ina njiyloo to mawɗo Nannan ; yimre ndee ina mawninee sabu nanngude sawtawol keewngol koɗli ɗii.
A large storage jar associated with Adic: Jarɗo mawɗo desorɗe jokkondirɗo e Adichanallur. Jaaruuji baawɗi ina njogii gawri, ndiyam e geɗe goɗɗe ; e nder wirwirnde, ɓulli ɗii ina mbaawi kadi wonde urneeji. Konngol “dolio” ina siftina en dolium, woni jardugel mawngel desorɗe aduna Roomnaaɓe.
A large, round-bellied funerary urn from: Urn mawɗo, reedu taariindi, ummoriiɗo Adichanallur. Urneeji hono ɗii ina mbaawi daraade ko ɓuri cukalel toowde, kadi waɗde ɗi ina ɗaɓɓi karallaagal mawngal : yimooɓe Sangam ina mbiya mbaylaandi waɗoowo urneeji ɗii ko wayi no கலம்செய் கோவே — “Oo laamɗo e nder mbaylaandi”.
A lead coin from Andipatti bearing a leg: Ko mbuuɗu mbuuɗu ummoriiɗo Andipatti ina waɗi lefol e ɗemngal Tamil-Brahmi. Gaa gaa laamɓe tato laamiiɓe ɓee, mawɓe nokkuuji ɗii e jamaanu Sangam ina njaltina kaalis e njamndi mboɗeeri, tawi leƴƴanɗe Tamil-Brahmi en ina mballita e waɗde inɗe e ɓeeɗoo laamɓe.
A line drawing of the vimana and a pilla: Natal diidi vimana e saal pilliir suudu dewal Brihadisvara.
A love poem of the Ten Idylls by Kapilar: Yimre giɗli e Idille sappo ɗe Kapilar winndi, waɗnde e leydi koɗli (kurinji). Aadaaji mbiyi ko ngam jannginde laamɗo worgo ŋarɗugol jimɗi giɗli Tamil; ina anndaa ina innira puɗi capanɗe jeenay e jeenay.
A modern artist’s imagining of a busy ha: Naalanke jamaanu ina miijo e laana ndiwoowa, luumooji e tooweeki, caggal sifaaji e nder Silappathikaram e Pattinappalai. Wonaa seede no wuro ngoo wayi tigi rigi.
A modern sketch imagining ships and buil: Sketch jamaanu ina miijo laanaaji e mahaaɗe to porto ɓooyɗo. Hono kala mahngo Puhar, ina firta sifaaji binndol ; laylaytol porto ngol timmungol anndaaka.
A name linked with Nedunalvadai and Tiru: Innde jokkondirnde e Nedunalvadai e Tirumurukarruppatai e nder Idillaaji sappo — hay so tawii ina waawi wonde ko ɓuri yimoowo gooto e nder yontaaji ceertuɗi. Lefol caggal ngol ina haala salaade makko rokkude ñaawoore makko e jimɗi hay to Siva to ñaawirdu Pandya : maande cuusal hakkille, wonaa kewu daartol.
A palm-leaf manuscript from the museum’s: Binndol lefol paltoor ummoraade e deftere musee.
A Pandya coin of the “massa” type. Massa: Ko mbuuɗu Pandya mo sifaa “massa”. Massa ko innde nde kaalis njamndi mboɗeeri rokkaa e jamaanu hakkundeejo holliroowo nate dariiɗe bannge gooto e nate jooɗiiɗe bannge goɗɗo — sifaa mo Chola en saakti, jokki e Pandya en e laamɓe Sri Lanka.
A Pandya coin showing a standing king wi: Koyngal Pandya hollirngal laamɗo dariiɗo e maande liɗɗi. Natal laamɗo dariiɗo, anndinaaɗo e kaalis njamndi Chola, ko Pandya en ƴetti ɗum nde doole mum en nguurti e teeminannde 13ɓiire.
A Pandya coin with the twin fish and a b: Ko Pandya coin e liɗɗi ɓiɗɓe ɗiɗo e nagge. Liɗɗi ɗiɗo ɗii ngonti maande Pandya duumotoonde, cirƴaande e banngeeji Madurai jimɗi ɗii, fiyraaɗe e mbuuɗu ko ina ɓura duuɓi ujunnaaje.
A pipeline of terracotta rings, set one: Tuubaako cirƴam terakotaaji, gonɗi dow goɗɗi e nder laylayti nay, peeñɗi e nder ɓuuɓri Korkai. Tuubaaji loope e ɓulli cirƴam hono ɗii ina njahda e ndiyam e nder gure leydi Tamil taariindi adanndi — ina jeyaa e innde ñalnde kala e nder porto keewɗo yimɓe.
A poem of the Ten Idylls by Kadiyalur Ur: Yimre sappo nde Kadiyalur Uruthirankannanar winndi, ina yetta laamɗo Chola biyeteeɗo Karikal Valavan e wuro mum porto Kaveripoompattinam (Puhar) ɓuuɓngo, e laanaaji mum, e luumooji mum, e juuldeeji mum.
A poem of the Ten Idylls by Nakkeerar. D: Yimre Idille sappo nde Nakkeerar winndi. E nder henndu juutndu, ɓuuɓndu, laamɗo debbo ina yiɗi jom suudu mum, laamɗo ina reena soldateeɓe mum gaañiiɓe e nder kasoo wolde.
A portrait coin of the Chera king Kuttuv: Natal laamɗo Chera Kuttuvan Kotai, innde mum e ɗemngal Tamil-Brahmi. E nder mbuuɗu Makkotai, ɗeen geɗe kaalis ɗe keewaani — ma a taw ko mbuuɗu pottital Roomnaaɓe aroowo e njulaagu — ina jeyaa e mbuuɗu Inndo gadano hollirde yeeso laamɗo.
A potsherd inscribed in Tamil-Brahmi, fo: Ko ɓuuɓri winndaa e ɗemngal Tamil-Brahmi, tawaa ko to Tissamaharama to fuɗnaange Sri Lanka, ko hedde teeminannde ɗiɗmere ko adii jibineede Iisaa. Binndol e ɗemngal Tamil e dow poɗɗe woɗɗuɗe e leydi Tamil mawndi ina hollita njulaagu Tamil ina golloroo sara maayo e nder yontaaji daartol puɗɗiiɗi.
A rare book from the first decades of Ta: Deftere nde heewaani yiyeede e duuɓi capanɗe gadani e binndol Tamil, nde binndi ɓooyɗi resndaaɗi e leɗɗe paltoor ina mbaɗee e binndol ko adii fof.
A rare volume digitised from CICT’s arch: Volume seeɗa dijital ummoraade e defterdu CICT, resndaa ngam janngude. Detaayuuji catal timmuɗi maa ɓeyde e juuɗe ardiiɓe musee oo.
A Sangam-age Chola coin with a tiger and: Kosam Chola mo duuɓi Sangam ina waɗi tiggu e kuɗol. Ko ɓuri heewde e kaalis Chola, ko ɓuri heewde e mum ko njamndi, ina woni hakkunde tiggu — ko kañum woni maande Chola laamɗo oo jogori nawde duuɓi ujunnaaje caggal ɗuum. Uraiyur e Kaveripoompattinam ko nokkuuji maɓɓe mawɗi.
A Sangam-age Pandya coin, typically a sm: Kosam Pandya mo duuɓi Sangam, ko ɓuri heewde ko kaaƴe tokoose ɗe njamndi mboɗeeri, ɗe elefant woni bannge gooto e liɗɗi stylized bannge goɗɗo. Hono ɗeen kaalis ina cirƴa e nder Madurai e saraaji mum, laamorgo Pandya mawninaaɗo to Maduraikkanchi.
A scholarly study of government, adminis: Jannde ganndal dow laamu, njuɓɓudi, e nguurndam renndo e nder leydi Tamil e jamaanu Sangam.
A second coin of the Kongu Cheras. Compa: Koyngal ɗiɗaɓal Kongu Cheras. Yerondir ɗiin ɗiɗi : kaalis baɗaaɗo e juuɗe ina seerti e strike, wear e cut, kadi hono ɗeen ceertuɗe ina mballita numismatiste en renndinde geɗe e reende no kaalis oo jogori juutde e cirkulaasiyoŋ.
A second image of the four-armed, seated: Natal ɗiɗaɓal Ganesha mo juuɗe nay, jooɗiiɗo. Yerondirde e njuuteendi maggal, e paabi maggal e njiimaandi maggal e adannde ndee : e nder canndolinɗo Silpa Sastras, kala sehil e gollorde ina acci toɓɓere mum.
A selection drawn from the Thirukkural,: Suɓngo ƴettaango e Thirukkural, mooftuɗo koppi ciftorɗi wonande janngooɓe.
A separate photographing of the opening: Fotooje ceertuɗe e leɗɗe udditooje ɓuuɓri 579 D, Maduraikkanchi.
Seniiɗo Shaiva, juuɗe kawri e dewal. Laamɓe Chola teddini Nayanmars cappanɗe jeegom e tato, ɓe Sekkizhar haali nguurndam maɓɓe nder Periya Puranam, e natal maɓɓe njamndi ndarnaama nder cuuɗi dewal, ɓe ɗon nastina nder juulde.
A sherd illustrated in Vimala Begley’s 1: Feccere hollirnde e nder wiɗto Vimala Begley e hitaande 1983 ko faati e ñalɗi Arikamedu. E ƴeewtaade laabi ɓuuɓɗi ɗii, Begley wiyi wonde koɗki nguu fuɗɗii ko hedde caka teeminannde tataɓere ko adii jibineede Iisaa — ko adii ko Mortimer Wheeler holliti — e jokkondiral Mediteraane e darorɗe teeminannde ɗiɗaɓere ko adii jibineede Iisaa. Date makko ina keddii e firo annduɓe.
A sherd of an urn found in 2004, decorat: Feccere urn tawaande e hitaande 2004, fawaade e relief appliqué e mbaydi debbo dariiɗo e nder motiiji keewɗi janngeede ko wayi no ƴiye paddorɗe, deer, crane e crocodile. Annduɓe njiyii e makko laamɗo yumma arano — won heen, no filmo oo wiyri nii, ko adii Kotravai, laamɗo hare yimre Sangam. Ko ɗum jeyi e natal fijirde seeɗa e jamaanu njamndi Tamil Nadu.
A short illustrated guide for visitors:: Ardorde juutnde hollirnde ngam yillotooɓe : hol ko woni jimɗi Sangam, hol no ɗi ndenndiniraa, e no jimɗi akam e puram e leyɗeele joy ɗee ngollirta.
A silver kasu of Rajendra Chola combinin: Kasu kaalis Rajendra Chola hawruɗo e maandeeji laamɗo — tiggu Chola e liɗɗi Pandya e Chera bow. Rajendra I (1014–1044 CE) nawti laamu Chola haa Ganges e taƴre maayo haa Asiya Fuɗnaange-rewo, e kaalis makko ina hollita wonde o ɓuri laamuuji Tamil tati ɗii fof.
A silver kasu of the “Uttama” type, attr: Kasu kaalis mo sifaa “Uttama”, sifotoo ɗoo ko Rajendra I. Sifaa oo ƴetti innde mum ko e kaalis Uttama Chola, mo diidi mum — tiggu, liɗɗi e bow les parasol — waɗi mbaydi kaalis Chola caggal ɗuum.
A simplified sequence of how cloth is ma: Koolondiral hoybinaangal no ɓoornungal waɗetee. Ina fammina laawol kuuɓtodinngol ngol ; wonaa seede wonde kala gollorde Tamil ɓooynde ina rewi heen tigi rigi ɗeeɗoo geɗe e ngalɗoo laawol — kuutorɗe, e doggol mbaylaandi e mbaylaandi, ina mbaawi seertude.
A small pottery cup from the Adichanallu: Koppi tokoosi ɓuuɓɗi ummoraade e wirwirnde Adichanallur. Koppe, taasaaji e ɓuuɓri ina njeyaa e ko ɓuri heewde e geɗe yanaande, e sifaaji mum en laaɓtuɗi, hay so ina kollita karallaagal poɗɗe gollotooɗe e taayaare fotde duuɓi ujunnaaje tati jooni.
A summit of Chola architecture, art and: Sommet mahdi, naalankaagal e njuɓɓudi Chola ; feccere e Templeeji Chola mawɗi wuurɗi UNESCO.
A temple gopuram over a Madurai street: Gopuram suudu dewal dow laawol Madurai
A vast open-air relief carved across two: Relief mawɗo udditirɗo weeyo, taƴaaɗo e kaaƴe ɗiɗi, anndiraaɗo Arjuna’s Penance walla Descent of the Ganga, ina hollira laamɓe, annduɓe, daabaaji, e galle elefant mawɗo no nguurndam nii, ina kawra e dow ŋoral tagoore.
A village on the Noyyal in Erode distric: Wuro dow Noyyal e nder diiwaan Erode, ɓuuɓnaango ngam wonde nokku peewnugol beɗi, gollorɗi gemha e peewnugol njamndi e aaludere.
A volume connected with the Madurai Tami: Deftere jokkondirnde e Sangam Tamil Madurai, duɗal binndol ngal Pandithurai Thevar sosi to Madurai e hitaande 1901, ngal heewi wiyeede ko « Sangam Tamil nayaɓal ».
A volume from the shrine’s collection of: Volume iwde e mooɓondiral firooji Thirukkural. Nelal Kural’en dow moƴƴere yotti janngooɓe nder ɗemɗe Indiya e ɗemɗe duniyaaru ɗuuɗɗe.
A volume on the poetry of Kambar, the gr: Deftere yimre Kambar, yimoowo mawɗo Kamba Ramayanam (Ramavataram), mo jaŋde mum e ɗemngal Tamil addani mo tiitoonde « Kavichakravarthi », laamɗo yimooɓe.

The first of the Ten Idylls (Pattuppattu: Ko adii fof e nder Idiluuji sappo (Pattuppattu), ko Nakkeerar yuɓɓini ɗum. E nder ndee “yimre ardotoonde” dewondirɗo barkinaaɗo e Joomiraawo Murugan ina ardina ɗaɓɓoowo goɗɗo feewde e makko, ina siftina hoɗorde makko jeegom ceniinde, Arupadai Veedu.

The foods that travelled with Tamil trad: Nyaamdu yahdundu e njulaagu Tamil — pepper ɓaleejo, jenngi e kurkuma ɗaɓɓaaɗo e nder geec Inndo, nebam sesame, jaggery palme e njuumri, e maaro mo yimɓe daande maayo ƴettata ngam waylude liɗɗi e lamɗam.
The four families of Tamil instruments:: Iwdiiji nay kuutorɗe Tamil : hidde — murasu laamɗo, parai, thavil, udukkai e pambai ; foofaango — nadaswaram e ɓuuɓri bamɗi; jolɗe — yazh bardiiɓe Sangam e veenai; e njamndi — thalam.
The Gangaikondacholeeswaram Temple and i: Temple Gangaikondacholeeswaram e keeri mum hannde, yiytaa ko e weeyo.
The Grand Anicut at work: water rushing: Grand Anicut e golle : ndiyam ina rutta e nder ɓulli mum, dow ɓulli mum, ina naata e nder ɓulli delta. Footage ummoraade e dokimaa dow Kallanai mo Duɗal Catal Tamil Classique waɗi.
The great courtyard seen through the pal: Ladde mawnde yi’eteende e nder coloŋaaji e arkeeji mawɗi palaas oo.
The heroine of Silappathikaram, who prov: Jaambaaro Silappathikaram, hollirɗo wonde jom suudu mum Kovalan alaa ko o waɗi e yeeso laamɗo Pandya, nde o udditi wuttulo makko : wuttulo makko ina joginoo rubiiji, perle laamɗo debbo. Ko o neɗɗo binndoowo wonaa neɗɗo daartol winnditiiɗo, o wonti maande nuunɗal — o rewetee ko Pattini e Kannaki Amman to Tamil Nadu, Kerala e Sri Lanka.
The image of Shiva as Nataraja, Lord of: Natal Shiva hono Nataraja, Joomiraawo Dance, ina yima e nder cirƴam ƴiiwoonde, ko sifaa njamndi Chola ɓurɗo mawnude. Ina hollita mbaydi tagoore, reende, e ɓuuɓde.
The Jambai inscription in Villupuram dis: Binndi Jambai to diiwaan Villupuram ina inniri “Satiyaputo Atiyan Netuman Anci”, ina jokkondiri e mawɓe Atiyaman en e Satiyaput en cifaaɗi e nder jamirooje Ashoka.
The Kadai Ezhu Vallalgal — Seven Great P: Kadai Ezhu Vallalgal — Jaagorgal mawngal jeeɗiɗi
The Kailasanatha Temple, a Pallava-perio: Temple Kailasanatha, suudu kaaƴe jamaanu Pallava, e cuuɗi tokoosi gonɗi e saraaji mum.
The kalayam, the everyday Tamil clay pot: Kalayam, ko pot loope Tamil ñalnde kala. Ɓanndu maggal ɓuuɓndu e wutte maggal ɓuuɓngal ina mbaɗa ndiyam cooyɗam e weeɓde nawde, kadi kalayam ina werlee haa jooni e dow ŋoral poɗɗe, ina ɓuuɓnee e nder ŋoral wuro — jokkondiral guurngal e laanaaji ɓuuɓɗi e nokkuuji Tamil en.
The Kallanai, or Grand Anicut, across th: Kallanai, walla Grand Anicut, sara Kaveri — ko adii fof ko laamɗo Chola Karikala — mahaa ngam yuɓɓinde e waylude ndiyam maayo ngoo e nder laabi ngam irtude. Nde waɗi delta Kaveri gooto e leyɗeele mawɗe ndema maaro e nder Tamil Nadu, haa hannde ina huutoroo njuɓɓudi ndiyam mum. (Ƴeew suudu Irrigation ngam ɓeydaade humpitaade ko fayti e innde ndiyam Tamil.)
The Kanchipuram silk saree is one of the: Saree silk Kanchipuram ina jeyaa e mbaydiiji gaadanteeji ɓurɗi mawnude e Tamil Nadu. Iwdi mum ko Kanchipuram, nokku taariindi njulaagu, oo saree ina anndaa e mbaydi mum silki alɗundi, golle zari caɗtuɗe, keeri ceertuɗi, e nate mum laaɓtuɗe. Motifs gaadanteeji ina mbaɗi cuuɗi temple, paawɗi, mangooji, puɗi, e diidi joometiri. Saree oo ina ɓoornee e mbaydi silki, e mbaydiiji zari daneeji kaŋŋe walla kaalis ina ɓeyda ngalu pawngu. Kanchipuram silk sarees ina jogii nokku mawɗo e nder dewgal Tamil, e kewuuji diine, e juuldeeji, e kewuuji goɗɗi teeŋtuɗi. Laawol wejo ngol ina ɗaɓɓi karallaagal mawngal, haa teeŋti noon so tawii ko jokkondirde e ɓanndu, keeri, e pallu kuutortooɗi karallaagal jokkondire gaadanteeje. Karallaagal ngal ƴellitii e nder yontaaji, tee hitaande sosnde maggal tigi rigi, tabitinaaka e daartol. Kancheepuram Silk heɓi njeenaari Geographic Indication (GI) e hitaande 2005. Hannde, saree ina hollita ndonu mbaylaandi Tamil Nadu, karallaagal karallaagal, e jokkude nguurndam renndooji mbaylaandi aadaaji.
The Kandangi saree is a traditional cott: Saree Kandangi ko mbaydi aadaaji jokkondirndi e diiwaan Chettinad, haa teeŋti e Karaikudi e nokkuuji koɗdiiɗi. Ina anndaa e ƴeewndorɗe mum cuuɗiiɗe, e mbaydiiji mum, e keeri mum ceertuɗi, e kalaaji mum tiiɗɗi, ina heen boɗeeji, mustard, oraas, e ɓaleejo leydi. E aadaaji, mbaydi maggal tiiɗndi ina fotnoo huutoreede e sahaa kala, ina hollita sarɗiiji gollorɗi e comci ñalnde kala. Wejo Kandangi ina hollita ganndal estetik e teskuyaaji ceertuɗi e diiwaan Chettinad. Patterns maggal e kalaaji maggal ina ceerti maggal e aadaaji sareeeji goɗɗi keewɗi e nder leydi Indiya. Laawol peewnugol ngol ina waɗi peewnugol mbaydiiji, yuɓɓinde mbaydiiji e dow loowdi ndii, ɓuuɓnude mbaydi ndii, e timminde keeri e timminde. Kaɓirɗe laamu nguu ina cifa wonde aadaaji ɗii ina ngoodi ko ina ɓura duuɓi 150, hay so tawii noon hitaande puɗɗagol mum laaɓtunde ina heddii ko laaɓtaani. Kandangi sarees keɓii njeenaari GI e hitaande 2019, wallitii anndude e hisnude sifaaji diiwaan mum en e golle mum en gaadanteeje.
The Kaveri in spate below the Grand Anic: Kaveri e nder spate les Anicut mawɗo. Yimɓe Tamil en ina njetta leydi Chola ko leydi Kaveri, ndi ngalu mum meeɗaa waasde ; Silappatikaram ina mawnina ɗum no leydi ndi alaa keerol. Anicut wayli ndeen boowal e njuɓɓudi njuɓɓudi, delta wonti ɓuuɓri maaro leydi Tamil.
The Kaveri rushing through the vents: Kaveri ina doga e nder ɓulli
The Koorainadu saree is associated with: Saree Koorainadu ina jokkondiri e Koorainadu sara Mayiladuthurai to leydi Tamil Nadu. Ina teskaa e ko jokkondiri e mbaydiiji dewgal gaadanteeji e nafoore pinal mbaydiiji e nder aadaaji dewgal Tamil. Feereeji gaadanteeji ina mbaɗi mbaydiiji silki e silki-koton, tawa ina waɗi diidi ceertuɗi e geɗe kuutorteeɗe fawaade e mbaadi e faandaare keeriinde. Saree ina hollita darnde comci ɓoornaaɗi e nder kewuuji galleeji teeŋtuɗi e jokkondire aadaaji mbaylaandi hakkunde yontaaji. Nafoore maggal, mbaydi maggal, e mbaadiiji maggal ina mbaawi seertude, ko ɗum waɗi yeruuji gooto gooto ina poti winndeede fawaade e mahngo mum en tigi-rigi tawa ina cikka wonde kala saree Koorainadu ina rewi laawol gootol. Hitaande iwdi ndee aada tigi rigi, laaɓtaani. Koorainadu sarees ina heddii e huunde nafoore ngam yuurnitaade jokkondire hakkunde koltu, mbaydi diiwaan, karallaagal, e nguurndam kewu e nder Tamil Nadu.
The Kovai Kora cotton saree is associate: Saree cotton Kovai Kora ina jokkondiri e Coimbatore e diiwaan mum peewnugol mbaylaandi. Waɗaa ko e cotton, ina weltinaa sabu ŋarɗugol mum teskinngol, mbaydi mum welndi, e keeri mum gaadanteeji. So en tuugniima e sarees silk pawaaɗi no feewi, mbaydiiji cotton Kora ina keewi teeŋtinde mbaadiiji cotton, ɓoornagol kuuɓtodinngol, e detaayuuji diisnondiral laaɓtuɗi. Saree oo ina hollita nafoore ndema cotton, peewnugol yarlitaare, njulaagu, e njulaagu mbaylaandi e nder leydi Tamil Nadu. Pewnugol saree junngo ina ɗaɓɓi peewnugol no moƴƴi ɓoggi warp e weft e golloraade loowdi ndii e karallaagal. Hotton kora ina moƴƴi e ñalɗi keewɗi, haa arti noon e ɓoornaade ñalnde kala e mooɓondiral. Kovai Kora Cotton heɓi njeenaari GI e hitaande 2008. Hitaande sosngo mum tigi-rigi tabitinaaka, kono aadaaji ɗii ina keddii e yeru teeŋtuɗo e ndonu cotton-weaving ceertuɗo e dowla oo.
The larger digitisation catalogued under: Dijital ɓurngal mawnude ngal catal les limoore wootere, 603 D : ko ina ɓura teemedde jeegom natal leɗɗe e nder ɓuuɓri ndi Kar Narpathu woni e mum ndii.
The Leiden plates record a Chola grant o: Leppi Leiden ina mbinnda dokkal Chola wuro wonande vihara Budisma to Nagapattinam, yamiroore Rajaraja I, yaltini ɗum e les njiimaandi Rajendra I. Jooni noon, ɗi ndewaama to Leiden, to Pays-Bas.
The literary image of ancient Tamil mari: Natal binndol ɓooyngal e ɓamtaare maayo Tamil.
The long pillared cloister that encloses: Koolaaɗo kuuɓal juutɗo pillirɗo mo taarii ladde suudu dewal Brihadisvara, e rowre lingams ndarnaa e dow leydi mum. Koɗorɗe mayre pentiraa ko e jamaanu Nayak e dille guurɗe — ɗoo Shiva’s pot-bellied ganas, gollodiiɓe makko ɓuuɓɓe fijooɓe — e les fedde Tamil captions. Caggal ɗeen nate caggal ɗuum, e nder laawol taariindi sanctum, ina woodi nate Chola asliije ɗe suudu dewal nduu waɗi.
The longest of the Ten Idylls, by Mangud: Ko ɓuri juutde e defte sappo ɗee, ko Mangudi Maruthanar winndi, o winndi ɗum laamɗo Pandya biyeteeɗo Nedunchezhiyan. Ina siftina wuro mawngo Madurai gila fajiri haa jamma, ina siftina laamɗo oo e nofru wonde teddeendi aduna fof ina rewa.
The lotus pool of Sittanavasal, the Pall: Poolgu lotus Sittanavasal, laamɗo debbo Pallava mo Panamalai, nate Chola e nate Nayak ɗe suudu dewal mawndu to Thanjavur, e nate Tanjore ɗe kaŋŋe.
The Madurai Sungudi saree is a tradition: Saree Madurai Sungudi ko mbaydi mbaylaandi aadaaji jokkondirndi e Madurai, nokku pinal e njulaagu taariindi to Tamil Nadu. Ina seerti e nate mum toɓɓere, e nate mum colourful, e karallaagal gaadanteewal tie-and-dye walla resist-dyeing. Taƴe tokoose e mbaydi ndii ina njuɓɓinee walla ina ndeenee e nder mbaydi mbaylaandi ngam waɗde nate ceertuɗe so huunde ndee ina ɓuuɓtoo. Tekstiiluuji Sungudi ina teddiniraa sabu mbaydi mum en ɓuuɓndi, mbaydi mum en ɓuuɓndi, e mbaydi mum en e comci ñalnde kala e ñalɗi. Karallaagal ngal ina hawra e ganndal peewnugol mbaydiiji, karallaagal jokkondire, mbaylaandi, e joofnirde. Iwdi maggal daartol jokkondirtaa e hitaande fuɗɗorde wootere winndaande e kisal. Madurai Sungudi heɓi njeenaari GI e hitaande 2005, ngam jaɓde jokkondiral mum e diiwaan oo. Aada oo ina hollita no artisaneeɓe Tamil en ƴellitiri diidi ceertuɗi e mbaydiiji mbaylaandi kuutortooɗi karallaagal keeringal e mbaydiiji peewnugol tabitinaaɗi e nokkuuji ɗii.
The masonry arches that now crown the an: Arches masonry ɗi jooni koronaaji weir ɓooyɗo. Injiniyankooɓe Angalteer jannguɓe Kallanai e teeminannde sappo e jeenayɓiire ina mbeltii e maggal : Sir Arthur Cotton janngii e maggal ko adii nde o mahata Anicut toowɗo oo e sara Kollidam e hitaande 1836, Richard Baird Smith ina manti maggal e kitaale 1850, sibu ko golle kaawniiɗe, duumiɗe e nder teeminanɗe keewɗe. Ko kamɓe inniri nde « Anicut mawɗo ».
The Meenakshi Amman Temple, historic str: Temple Meenakshi Amman, laabi taariiha, aadaaji diina, e jokkude golle binndol e pinal ina njokkondiri e Madurai hannde oo e daartol mum juutngol.
The memorial hall to Karikal Chozhan at: Koolol ciftorgol Karikal Chozhan to Kallanai, ngol laamu leydi Tamil Nadu ummini. Karikalan, jaambaaro Pattinappalai e Porunararruppadai, ina siftoree e aadaaji Tamil en wonde laamɗo tammiiɗo Kaveri en. Caggal mum jimɗi Chola ko wayi no Kulothunga Cholan Ula, e binndi laamuuji wiyooɓe iwdi makko, ina mbiya ko kanko ummini bankeeji Kaveri.
The mini-map in the corner shows the who: Kartal tokosal gonngal e ŋoral ina hollita musee oo fof ; feggere boɗeere ndee ko aan, ina holla laawol ngol njiylotoɗaa. Uddit kartal timmungal (walla butoŋ Kartal) cuɓo-ɗaa kala saal walla suudu ngam yahde toon.
The monuments of Mamallapuram, carved ma: Monumndaaji Mamallapuram, ceŋtaaɗi ko ɓuri heewde e teeminannde 7ɓiire e 8ɓiire caggal Iisaa, ina mbaɗi cuuɗi cafrirɗi taƴaaɗi e kaaƴe, rathas gooto, e cuuɗi dewal Shore gonɗi e mbaydi. Fedde ndee ko nokku ndonu winndere UNESCO.
The monuments themselves, with Pallava i: Monumndaaji ɗii e koye mum en, ina heen binndi Pallava e tiitooɗe laamɓe.
The most celebrated of the Seven Great P: Ɓuri mawnineede e Patrons mawɗi jeeɗiɗi ɗii. Aadaaji Tamil ina ciftora mo rokkude puccu makko e jasmine (mullai) creeper mo alaa ko waawi ƴeeŋde — yaafuya yettotoo ko ɓuri yimɓe haa e aduna tagoore. Sehilaagal makko e yimoowo Kapilar, daɗndude Parambu Nadu e laamɓe tato laamɓe, e woyde ɓiɓɓe makko rewɓe Angavai e Sangavai (Purananuru 112) ina ndesndaa e yimre Sangam ; daartol puccu ɓuri moƴƴude janngeede ko aada binndol.
The mountains and the land around them,: Koye e leydi taariindi, hakkunde jamma e sahaa cooyɗo. Laamɗo maggal ko Murugan (Seyon), puɗol maggal ko kurinji, puɗol mum ko laawol gootol e nder duuɓi sappo e ɗiɗi. Tiitoonde mayre ko punarthal, pottital sirlu yiɗɓe. Yimɓe mayre ina moofta njuumri, ina ndeena gese millet e mborosaaji, ina njuula e nder ladde.
The murasu is the great drum of Sangam l: Murasu ko tammborde mawnde binndol Sangam, ina fiyee ngam laamɓe, ngam hare, ngam anndinde yimɓe e kewuuji — daande mum ko e hoore mum wonnoo maande laamu laamɗo. Tamborɗe biyeteeɗe murasu ina gasa tawa ina ceerti e mawneeki, e kaɓirɗe e suspension e nder sahaaji, ko ɗum waɗi hay tamborde hannde wootere wonaa ko nanndi heen tigi rigi ; reconstructions ko firooji binndanɗe ɗee.
The museum’s historical research guide t: Koolaaɗo kuuɓal wiɗto taariindi musee oo ngam ƴellitde weeyo e nder Tamil Nadu gila e jamaanu ɓooyɗo haa hannde : limto sahaa, kaɓirɗe e peeje, seedeeji binndanɗe Sangam e arkewolosi, jamaanu hakkundeejo, koloñaal e jamaanu hannde, e iwdiiji mum, e ɗemngal Engele.

The museum’s notes on eight saree tradit: Note musee’en dow aadaaji sareeji joweeɗiɗi Tamil Nadu — ɗo kala heen fuu ɓoornaama, no, e nde heɓi anndinde Geographical Indication — e ɗemngal Engele.
The museum’s notes on fifteen foods and: Note museum’en dow nyaamdu sappo e jowi e kuuje taariiha nyaamdu Tamil, gila e maaro e njuumri haa e kuuje palme e nyaamdu dow lekki banaana, bee nate limtaaɗe, bee ɗemngal Engele.

The museum’s notes on Vel Pari, in Engli: Note musee oo e Vel Pari, e ɗemngal Engele.
The museum’s research guide to ancient T: Ardorde wiɗto musee oo e njulaagu Tamil ɓooyngu : limto waktuuji gila e mbayliigu adanngu haa e resooji portooji yontaaji hakkundeeji, e daartol e seedeeji portooji e nokkuuji njulaagu jeenay, nanndiraaɗi e alluwal udditirgal.
The nadaswaram is the great double-reed: Nadaswaram ko kuutorgal mawngal henndu gonngal e ƴiye ɗiɗi, ngal njimri temple Tamil, ngal diwtata ko e juuldeeji, dewgal e yah-ngartaa. Ɓanndu leɗɗe juutndu, ɓuuɓndu koppi, ina joofna e beldital ɓuuɓngal; reed e bore ina ndokka tonngoode mum doole, nawnde. E ɗaɓɓude ƴeewndo foofaango e tonngoode laaɓtunde, ina fija improvisations classiques juutɗe, ragas e compositions — ko ɓuri heewde e gollondiral e thavil.
The name seems to have been borne by mor: Innde ndee wayi ko no ko ɓuri debbo yimoowo gooto jibini ɗum. Yimre Sangam Avvaiyar nder Purananuru, Akananuru, Kurunthogai e Natrinai ɗon wolwa dow laamɓe, yaafuye e maayde; ko o wasiyaajo Adhiyaman koolaaɗo. Ɗemɗe sukaaɓe ɓooyɗe ɗe Aathichudi, Kondrai Vendhan e Nalvazhi njeyaa ko e Avvaiyar caggal mum.
The Noyyal River region of Tamil Nadu pr: Diiwaan maayo Noyyal to Tamil Nadu ina rokka yeru goɗɗo e njuɓɓudi ndiyam rewrude e lowre tankiiji e laabi jokkondirɗi. So wonaa fawaade e doggol maayo toowngol tan, renndooji ɗii ƴettii peeje desorɗe ballitooje nanngugol e renndinde ndiyam keɓaaɗam. Tankaaji e nder ɗeen resooji ina mbaawi mooftude toɓooli e ndiyam ɓuuɓɗam, ina moofta ɗum ngam huutoraade ndema caggal ɗuum. Nafoore majji fawii ko e yuɓɓo leydi ndii, e ngonka jolɗe ɗee, e mbaawka jolɗe ɗee e sahaa toɓooli ɗii. So tawii ko no moƴƴiri, lowre jokkondirnde ina wallita e sarde ngalu ndiyam keewɗam e nder nokkuuji keewɗi. Siistem maayo Noyyal ina anndaa kadi e nder binndanɗe ndonu ndiyam leydi Indiya. Operetor oo ina jippina lowre ndee e nder ndiyam, ina ƴetta nde ngam ustude ndiyam e nder kanndaa walla e nder ladde. Golle binndaaɗe Tamil, ina heen Ahananuru, Maduraikanchi e Silappadikaram, ina njogii nate firooje ko seedeeji golle ƴellitgol ndiyam, e binndanɗe daartol ina ciftina leyɗeele ndiyam kuutorteeɗe e kaɓirɗe nannduɗe e picottah. Ɗee kuutorɗe ina teskanoo e nokkuuji tokoosi, ndema gese e gese tawaaɗe dow ndiyam.
Where rain was scarce and the land drier: Ɗo toɓo ŋakki, leydi ndii ɓuri yoorde, remooɓe Tamil en ina ndema ƴiye ko wayi no kambu e varagu, e saraaji ƴiye, sesame e cotton. Suɓaade gese ngam yahdude e kala leydi, toɓo e ndiyam ko ganndal ngal jimɗi Sangam kolliri tawo — e millet ina heddii e gese mawɗe Tamil Nadu hannde.
With Puhar, one of the two centres of ea: E Puhar, gooto e nokkuuji ɗiɗi laamu Chola puɗɗiingu e dow Kaveri.
With the imperial Cholas came a confiden: Wondude e Cholas laamɗo oo ari ko kaalis hoolaare e kaŋŋe, kaalis e njamndi. Koyɗe Uttama Chola e darorɗe teeminannde 10ɓiire ina njogii innde makko, gila Rajaraja I haa yeeso, maande laamɗo oo ina hollira tiggu Chola jooɗiiɗo ina wondi e liɗɗi ɗiɗi Pandya les parasol, innde laamɗo oo ina winndaa e binndol Nagari. Caggal nde Chola heɓti Sri Lanka, sifaa njamndi mboɗeeri holliroowo laamɗo dariiɗo bannge gooto e nate jooɗiiɗe bannge goɗɗo oo, yaaji e nder leydi Inndo fuɗnaange e duunde ndee. Nafooje ina limtee e kalanju e kasu — konngol rokkungol Engele “kaalis” mum.
